revenue-by-category.pg:
SELECT category, count(*) AS orders, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
revenue-by-category.ch:
SELECT category, count(*) AS orders, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

busiest-customer-days.pg:
SELECT user_id, CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS day, count(*) AS orders
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id, day
ORDER BY orders DESC, user_id, day
LIMIT 20
busiest-customer-days.ch:
SELECT user_id, CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS day, count(*) AS orders
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id, day
ORDER BY orders DESC, user_id, day
LIMIT 20

users-by-signup-year.pg:
SELECT extract(year FROM signup_date) AS yr, plan, count(*) AS users, avg(2026 - birth_year) AS avg_age
FROM users
GROUP BY yr, plan
ORDER BY yr, plan
users-by-signup-year.ch:
SELECT extract(year FROM signup_date) AS yr, plan, count(*) AS users, avg(2026 - birth_year) AS avg_age
FROM users
GROUP BY yr, plan
ORDER BY yr, plan

daily-orders.pg:
SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS day, count(*) AS orders, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2025-03-01' AND created_at < '2025-06-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
daily-orders.ch:
SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS day, count(*) AS orders, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2025-03-01' AND created_at < '2025-06-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

running-monthly-revenue.pg:
WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS revenue_cents
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month, revenue_cents, sum(revenue_cents) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_cents
FROM t
ORDER BY month
running-monthly-revenue.ch:
SELECT month, revenue_cents, sum(revenue_cents) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_cents
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS revenue_cents
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
) t
ORDER BY month

distinct-buyers-per-month.pg:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyers
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
distinct-buyers-per-month.ch:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyers
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

price-percentiles.pg:
SELECT category,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_cents) AS p50,
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_cents) AS p90
FROM orders
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
price-percentiles.ch:
SELECT category,
       quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(price_cents) AS p50,
       quantileExactInclusive(0.9)(price_cents) AS p90
FROM orders
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

revenue-by-country.pg:
SELECT u.country, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.quantity * o.price_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.country
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, u.country
LIMIT 20
revenue-by-country.ch:
SELECT u.country, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.quantity * o.price_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.country
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, u.country
LIMIT 20

top-customers.pg:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT user_id, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS spent_cents, count(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY user_id
  ORDER BY spent_cents DESC, user_id
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.country, t.spent_cents, t.orders
FROM t
JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id
ORDER BY t.spent_cents DESC, u.id
top-customers.ch:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT user_id, sum(quantity * price_cents) AS spent_cents, count(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY user_id
  ORDER BY spent_cents DESC, user_id
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.country, t.spent_cents, t.orders
FROM t
JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id
ORDER BY t.spent_cents DESC, u.id

card-share-by-country.pg:
SELECT u.country, count(*) AS orders,
       100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS card_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.country
HAVING count(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY card_pct DESC, u.country
card-share-by-country.ch:

FROM orders o

GROUP BY u.country
HAVING count(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY card_pct DESC, u.country

email-city-search.pg:
SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, city
FROM users
WHERE email ILIKE '%son%' AND city ILIKE 'san%'
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 50
